S6_2_1_001_valid__nil.rationale: Source and oracle reviewed independently of the draft authors; see doc/source_audits/lexical_batch_003.json. R1526-R1528 and C1538-C1544 admit the conditional argument with integer expression 37 and .NIL. for the optional INTENT(IN) integer dummy. Under 15.5.2.3 p1-p2, selecting 37 supplies that argument and selecting .NIL. makes it absent. PRESENT has precisely the checked result under 16.9.163 p3-p5, and the absent dummy is never referenced for its value. GNU rejects the syntax; Flang's f2018 mode fails at the F2023 question mark. Neither observation refutes the F2023 source oracle, and neither is counted as reference validation.
